n1.speaker: maya
n1.text: Hello again! You're running. Are you OK? The Brighton train's changed platforms. Did you hear the announcement?

translations.fa: دوباره سلام! داری می‌دوی. خوبی؟ قطار برایتون سکوش عوض شده. اعلامیه را شنیدی؟

branches.suggestion: No! Which platform is it now?
I heard something, but I didn't understand.

n2.speaker: maya
n2.text: "The 11:15 to Brighton is now departing from platform 17." Not 14. Look at the big board. It's over there, at the end.

translations.fa: «قطار ۱۱:۱۵ به برایتون اکنون از سکوی ۱۷ حرکت می‌کند.» نه ۱۴. تابلوی بزرگ را ببین. اونجاست، ته.

branches.suggestion: Platform 17. How long have I got?

cultureNote.en: Platforms can change at the last minute in UK stations. Always check the departure boards and listen for announcements.
cultureNote.fa: سکو ممکن است در دقیقهٔ آخر عوض شود؛ همیشه تابلوها را چک کنید.

n3.speaker: maya
n3.text: Four minutes. Walk quickly, don't run on the stairs. I'm on that train too — I'll walk with you.

translations.fa: چهار دقیقه. تند راه برو، رو پله‌ها ندو. منم سوار همون قطارم — باهات میام.

branches.suggestion: Thank you! Is this the train to Brighton?

match: this is the train to brighton?
recasts.echo: Is this the train to Brighton? Yes!
recasts.better: Is this the train to Brighton?

n4.speaker: maya
n4.text: This is it. It calls at Clapham Junction, East Croydon, Gatwick, then Brighton. Only the front four coaches go to Brighton!

translations.fa: خودشه. تو کلپم جانکشن، ایست کرویدون، گتویک، بعد برایتون توقف می‌کنه. فقط چهار واگن جلو تا برایتون میرن!

branches.suggestion: What happens to the other coaches?
I'm at the back. Am I in the wrong part?

n5.speaker: maya
n5.text: The back coaches split at Haywards Heath and go somewhere else. Lots of people end up in Littlehampton by mistake!

translations.fa: واگن‌های عقب تو هیوردز هیث جدا میشن و میرن یه جای دیگه. خیلی‌ها اشتباهی سر از لیتل‌همپتون درمیارن!

branches.suggestion: Oh no! I'll move to the front now.

n6.speaker: maya
n6.text: They do! Walk through the train while it's at the platform. Coach A to D. You've got two minutes.

translations.fa: میشن! تا قطار تو سکوئه از داخلش رد شو. واگن A تا D. دو دقیقه وقت داری.

branches.suggestion: Coach C. Is there a seat?
Thank you, Maya. You saved my day!
branches.suggestionFa: ممنون مایا. روزم را نجات دادی!

n7.speaker: maya
n7.text: Coach C is quiet. Sit down and relax. And next time — always check the board, then listen. Platforms love to change!

translations.fa: واگن C خلوته. بشین و استراحت کن. دفعهٔ بعد — همیشه تابلو را چک کن، بعد گوش بده. سکوها عاشق عوض شدنن!
